ExecutionWorkloadState.description: Mechanical state of the Kubernetes workload behind one execution generation.

oneOf.description: The workload object exists but has not started its main container.
The main container terminated with a successful exit.
The main container terminated with a non-zero exit or an execution deadline.
The workload object is absent while the durable attempt still expects it.
The backend could not determine the state; callers must keep the attempt unresolved.

UtcTimestamp.description: UTC timestamp serialized with a literal `Z` and millisecond precision.

description:
Bounded, payload-free observation of one admitted workload.

The observation never carries container output, terminal text, or role-specific receipts.
Business services map their own receipt format from the execution backend's role adapter.

exitCode.description: Main container exit code, present only for a terminated main container.

podName.description: Deterministic pod name observed for the workload, when one exists.

reasonCode.description: Bounded Kubernetes reason such as `DeadlineExceeded`, `OOMKilled`, or `Error`.

startedAt.description: Main container start time as reported by Kubernetes.

terminatedAt.description: Main container termination time as reported by Kubernetes.

title: ExecutionObservation
